title: Fix expense policy category mode
summary: The Expense Policies page now locks the expense category field when opened for a specific category, automatically applies that category to new policies, and reads page-link filters from supported filter groups.
key_points: The category field is locked when the Expense Policies page is opened for a single category
New expense policies get the filtered category automatically
The page-link filter is read from the supported filter groups
quote: Lock the expense category field when the page is opened for one category.
